Permafrost Rune
39% of base mana
1 sec cast1 min cooldown
Requires Frozen Target
Inscribe a rune of permafrost and unleash it on an enemy, incapacitating them for 40 sec (10 sec vs players). Damage taken will end the effect.

Affected enemies are considered Frozen.

Using this while in Runeshroud causes it to incur an 80% reduced cooldown.
